overview_description.description: Conveo is an AI-powered qualitative research platform that helps enterprise teams gather deep customer insights fast. It uses voice and video interviews, not avatars, to capture authentic, human responses. Conveo’s AI then analyzes these multimodal inputs to extract themes, quotes, and actionable insights. Ideal for marketing, product, CX, and innovation teams who want real qualitative data without slow, manual analysis.
